title: The entropy-rate dimension formula for self-similar measures

result.label: The entropy-rate dimension formula for self-similar measures
result.statement: For every self-similar measure on the line generated by finitely many contracting similarities, proves H = 1,h RW / , where h RW is the entropy rate of random composed maps and χ the average logarithmic contraction. This resolves the entropy-rate dimension conjecture without a separation assumption, allowing exact overlaps and unequal contraction ratios.
